system.description:
This skill only produces an effect when you have only a single [One-Handed] weapon with the [Light] tag equipped to a [Hand Slot]. You gain a +[[DEX Mod] x 2] bonus to [Attack Power]. You gain a +[SRx5] bonus to damage rolls made while [Hidden].

A fighting style that manipulates well-handled weapons and unleashes powerful blows from the enemy's blind spots.
